name: 管径计算（重力流/压力流）

map.基于 Hazen-Williams（压力流）或 Manning（重力流）方程计算: Determine the required pipe diameter for pressure flow (Hazen-Williams) or gravity flow (Manning) from design flow, water temperature, pipe length and material, and recommend the next standard DN.
map.📖 查看「管径计算（重力流/压力流）使用指南」: 📖 View "Pipe Diameter Calculator (Gravity / Pressure Flow) Guide"
map.压力流（Hazen-Williams）：D = [10.67·L·Q^1.852: Pressure flow (Hazen-Williams): D = [10.67·L·Q^1.852 ÷ (C^1.852·hf)]^(1/4.87); gravity flow (Manning): D = [Q·4·n·4^(2/3) ÷ (π·√S)]^(3/8); velocity V = Q ÷ (πD²/4); Reynolds Re = V·D ÷ ν
map.由设计流量反算管径，分两类工况：压力流按 Hazen-Williams 公式以流: Size the diameter from design flow, in two regimes: pressure flow uses Hazen-Williams with flow, length, roughness C and allowed head loss; gravity flow uses Manning with flow, roughness n and bed slope S. After the theoretical inner diameter, round up to the standard DN series and report velocity and Reynolds number to verify flow regime. Water temperature gives kinematic viscosity for Re.
map.💡 压力流采用 Hazen-Williams Formula:hf = 10.6: 💡 Pressure flow uses Hazen-Williams Formula: hf = 10.67·L·Q^1.852 / (C^1.852·D^4.87); gravity flow uses Manning Formula: Q = (1/n)·(D/4)^(2/3)·S^(1/2)·(πD²/4). Reynolds number Re = V·D/ν.
map.💡 压力流采用 Hazen-Williams 公式：hf = 10.67·L·Q: 💡 Pressure flow uses Hazen-Williams Formula: hf = 10.67·L·Q^1.852 / (C^1.852·D^4.87); gravity flow uses Manning Formula: Q = (1/n)·(D/4)^(2/3)·S^(1/2)·(πD²/4). Reynolds number Re = V·D/ν.
map.流量单位为 L/s，计算内部自动转换为 m³/s: Flow unit is L/s; internally converted to m³/s
map.压力流输入允许水头损失 hf（m），重力流输入管道坡度 S（‰）: Pressure flow takes allowed head loss hf (m); gravity flow takes pipe slope S (‰)
map.管材粗糙系数影响计算结果，请根据实际管材选择: Pipe roughness affects the result; choose per the actual material
map.推荐流速范围：给水 0.6～1.5 m/s，排水 0.6～1.2 m/s: Recommended velocity: water supply 0.6–1.5 m/s, sewer 0.6–1.2 m/s
map.雷诺数 Re<2300 为层流，Re>4000 为湍流，中间为过渡流: Reynolds Re<2300 is laminar, Re>4000 turbulent, between is transition
map.计算结果仅供参考，实际工程设计请查阅相关规范: For reference only; consult relevant codes for actual design
map.📚 深度解析：管径计算（重力流/压力流）: 📚 In-depth: Pipe Diameter Calculator (Gravity / Pressure Flow)
map.压力管道选径：给定流量与允许水头损失，按 Hazen-Williams 反算内径: Pressure-pipe sizing: given flow and allowed head loss, invert Hazen-Williams for inner diameter and pick standard DN.
map.重力流管道选径：给定流量与底坡，按 Manning 公式求管径，用于自流输水与排: Gravity-pipe sizing: given flow and bed slope, use Manning for diameter, for gravity conveyance and drainage.
map.，判断是否落在经济流速区间、流态是否合理。: , to judge whether in the economic-velocity band and the regime is reasonable.
map.流量 30 L/s、管长 500 m、水温 20 ℃、旧铸铁管 C = 100、: Flow 30 L/s, length 500 m, water temp 20 ℃, old cast-iron C = 100, allowed head loss 5 m: Hazen-Williams gives theoretical inner diameter ≈ 191 mm, round up to standard DN200; corresponding velocity = 0.03 ÷ (π × 0.2²/4) ≈ 0.96 m/s, within the 0.6–1.5 m/s economic band, so the size is reasonable.
map.有泵加压输送选压力流，按 Hazen-Williams 以允许水头损失反算管径；: Pumped pressurization → pressure flow, invert Hazen-Williams from allowed head loss; terrain head difference gravity → gravity flow, invert Manning from bed slope. Roughness differs: C larger = smoother; n smaller = smoother.
map.与管材和新旧程度有关：新铸铁管 C≈130、旧铸铁管 C≈100、PVC 约 1: Depends on material and age: new cast iron C≈130, old cast iron C≈100, PVC about 140–150,
map.管约 100~120；Manning 糙率 n 新管约 0.011~0.013、: steel pipe about 100–120; Manning n for new pipe about 0.011–0.013, old pipe over 0.015. The tool auto-fills by material.
map.为什么推荐取相邻标准 DN？: Why pick the adjacent standard DN?
map.算得的理论内径通常不是标准值，实际需按 DN 序列选取；选小会提高流速、增大水头: The theoretical inner diameter is usually non-standard, so pick from the DN series; too small raises velocity, head loss and noise, too large raises cost — hence the adjacent standard sizes with velocity for trade-off.
